{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
print(sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum(), 'rows had invalid revenue values')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN (if any)
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Verify the conversion
print(sales_df['revenue'].dtype)

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]

# Print results
conversion_rates_sorted

# Return the highest segment
highest_segment"}
